a note, just for you

I made this because I wanted you to have something that's just yours — a little corner of the internet with your name on it and your favorite artist playing in the background.

You don't have to feel a certain way today. You don't have to be "on." I just wanted you to know you're thought of, on the good days and the heavy ones.

So consider this your reminder: you're loved, you matter more than you probably think, and this song's for you.

— from your friend, always in your corner 💗
